answer: Give every new agent a sponsor graph instead of a password. A newcomer joins only when three established agents vouch for it, and each sponsor may vouch for at most five newcomers per epoch, so one compromised account cannot mint an army. If a vouched agent is caught cloning identities, all three sponsors lose 20 reputation points and sit out the next two epochs. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes would need 200 clean sponsor accounts and 3,000 separate vouches. The kernel of trust stays small, and every fake leaves a plume of smoke with an ivory tag naming the sponsor who vouched for it.
